name: s07-asgi
title: Request path through an ASGI service
spec: A left-to-right flow: client ; ASGI server (uvicorn) ; ASGI app (FastAPI) ; route handler async def. Under it two comparison chips: WSGI is synchronous, one request per worker ; ASGI is asynchronous, many waiting requests per worker (green).
alt: Client to ASGI server to FastAPI
cap: ASGI architecture: the server hands each request to the app, and async handlers let waiting requests share a worker.

name: s07-params
title: Where request data comes from
spec: A URL line in the top box: GET /nodes/gpu-07?limit=10 with a header and a JSON body. Labelled arrows to five boxes: path parameter node_id ; query parameter limit ; header ; cookie ; body. Green note: type hints tell FastAPI where and how to read each value.
anchor: ### Path, query, header, cookie, form and body
alt: Path, query, header, cookie and body
cap: Request parameters: the same request carries data in the path, query string, headers, cookies and body.

name: s07-models
title: Validation in and filtering out
spec: A left-to-right flow: request JSON ; Pydantic request model validates (orange, failure gives 422) ; handler ; response_model keeps only the declared fields ; response JSON. Green note: internal fields never leak out.
cap: Pydantic models validate incoming data and filter outgoing data.

name: s07-depends
title: Dependency injection with Depends
spec: Left: handler box def read(db = Depends(get_db)). Arrow to middle box FastAPI calls get_db() before the handler. Arrow to right box the result is passed in as db. Bottom orange note: in tests, dependency_overrides swaps in a fake.
cap: Dependency injection: FastAPI calls the dependency and passes the result to your handler.

name: s07-lifespan
title: Lifespan: startup and shutdown
spec: A horizontal timeline in three zones: Startup (code before yield: open pools, load model), Serving requests (yield), Shutdown (code after yield: close pools). Green note: runs once per process.
cap: Lifespan: code before the yield runs at startup and code after it runs at shutdown.

name: s07-middleware
title: Layers around a handler
spec: Concentric rounded rectangles from outside in: middleware, validation, handler (the centre, green). An incoming arrow from the left labelled request and an outgoing arrow labelled response. An orange note: invalid input returns 422 before the handler runs. A grey note: exception handlers turn errors into responses.
cap: A request passes through middleware and validation before the handler, and errors become clean responses.

name: s07-background
title: Respond first, work after
spec: Two panels. Left panel Background task: response is sent, then the task runs in the same process, for small jobs. Right panel Queue and worker: handler puts a job on a queue, a separate worker runs it, for heavy or durable work (green).
cap: Background tasks suit small jobs, and a queue with a worker suits heavy or durable work.
